Container.Name: HDHomeRunDVR
Container.Overview:
Docker container for the HDHomeRun DVR Server by SiliconDust.
Features Runs the HDHomeRun DVR recording engine inside a Docker container supervisord keeps the process alive — auto-restarts if the DVR daemon crashes Container-level restart: unless-stopped policy recovers from container failures Timezone configurable via the TZ environment variable Host networking for full HDHomeRun device discovery (UDP broadcast)
Container.Requires: A working HDHomeRun network tuner with up-to-date firmware (see below)
